description.value: A named motion from `@trentesix/core/moments.css`. Space-separated, so one element can carry more than one.
**PresenceStack.** someone joins: their avatar slides into the stack, then part `ring` pings three times (Discothèque) or its `ink` circle draws itself around the avatar (Folio).
**ChangeMark.** something someone else just changed (yours is a `flash`), when added: part `bar` draws down the edge, part `highlight` sweeps the words, then both fade over about 4 s.

**CodeField.** parts `cell` (`data-filled`), each holding its digit in a child element; `data-state="done"` closes the gaps and draws a tick; `failed` shakes or edges in rust, then the digits leave right to left (clear them after about 1 s).

**CopyButton.** part `icon` holds the copy glyph and the tick's SVG (the one with part `ink`) in one centred cell; `data-state="done"` swaps them and draws the tick. Part `tag` ("Copied") rises and fades after a second.
**Count, Badge.** `count(el, value)` rolls the digits that changed; it fills the element with digit columns (part `digit`), so the element holds only the number.

**Sign-in page.** `data-state="done"` when signed in: the five children of part `bands` sweep up and lift away (Discothèque), or are pulled across as hazard tape and lift away (Devis); part `card` steps back and part `view` (the Studio) rises (Folio).

**Upload tile.** an uploaded image develops like a print with the upload: set `--progress` (0 to 1). Part `image` goes from soft to sharp (Folio: grey to colour), part `progress` fills; `data-state="done"` flashes (Discothèque) or draws the `ink` tick in part `badge` (Folio).

**Dialog, Popover, Menu.** Discothèque rises 16 px with `--spring-pop` and its shadow grows as it lands; Folio rises 8 px from 98% with `--spring-settle`. The backdrop (`::backdrop`, or part `backdrop` next to the panel) fades. `data-state="leaving"` closes it.

**TextField, every field.** on the box around the input; `data-invalid`: Discothèque shakes once, Folio draws a rust line under the field. Part `message` (inside, or a sibling after it) drops in (Folio: rises).

**Anything you just changed.** something you just changed, away from where you clicked, when added or with `flash(el)` (which plays it again on an element already marked): the background takes `--flash` and fades back to its own. Discothèque hits at once in marigold, holds a beat and fades over three drifts; Folio's pale wash soaks in like ink, then dries. Under reduced motion the colour still shows and fades in 200 ms. Someone else's change is a `change-mark`.
**Button `intent="destroy"`.** `hold(button, {ms, onConfirm})`; part `fill` grows while held, drains if released early. The button gets `data-state="busy"` while held and `done` at the end.
**Sortable lists.** `data-state="lifted"`: the row rises and tilts (Discothèque) or lifts 1.5% with a shadow (Folio).

**Celebration.** first publish and other firsts, when added: part `card` lands, its `ink` seal draws, one burst: ten strips in part `confetti` (Discothèque) or part `rays` (Folio). `data-state="leaving"` fades it.

**Accepted document (Devis).** the seal pressed on a document that now binds: an SVG with two `ink` circles (`pathLength="1"`, outer first), a `word` and a `date` text, on its own paper disc at -8deg. Devis presses it in with `--spring-pop` and jolts the `thud` around it 1 px; other looks draw the rings and fade the words in. `data-state="rest"` shows it without playing (a record opened later); `leaving` fades it.

**AI suggestion diff.** when added, part `del` gets a line drawn through it, then part `ins` writes itself in, underline and all. `data-state="done"` (accepted) folds `del` away and settles `ins` into plain ink.

**Sent reply (Relais).** a cancellation mark added to the page when something is sent: an SVG with `ink` rings and wavy lines (`pathLength="1"`, rings first) and a `date` text. Relais presses it in with `--spring-settle`, then it settles back to `--postmark-rest` (0.72); other looks draw the ink in order and fade the date in. `data-state="leaving"` fades it.

**Button.** `data-moment="press"`; reacts to `:active` and `data-pressed`. Discothèque presses into its shadow (`--press`; set it lower on a button without one), Folio sinks 1 px and darkens a shade. Lands in 90 ms and lets go 90 ms later at the earliest. `data-state="busy"` shows the busy cue: stripes roll inside (Discothèque), a line runs along the bottom (Folio).

**SaveButton.** `data-state="dirty|busy|done|failed"`; dirty shows a dot (part `dot`) that pings once, busy shows the busy cue, done draws a tick (part `ink`), failed shakes (Folio: a rust line along the bottom). `data-shortcut` flashes the press when ⌘S was used. This is also the unsaved state and the ⌘S press.

**StatusPill.** Folio's publish, and approve and schedule in both looks. `data-state="done"`: part `fill` sweeps in, the `ink` writes itself in order (a ring, then a tick), part `rays` sparks once, part `edge` draws down the card, part `label` firms up, part `badge` pops onto an avatar. `failed` (changes asked) does the same without ink.
**Segmented, Tabs.** part `indicator`, placed by `slide()` through `--x` and `--w`; glides between options.

**Stamp (Discothèque).** thuds down with a slight turn when added, and lifts off after 1.8 s; the page gives a 2 px jolt (`data-moment="thud"` on the container, which jolts when a stamp lands in it or on `data-state="done"`; in Devis, 1 px when a `notary` seal is pressed in it).

**New row or panel (Relais).** the element holds a part `band`, which arrives once along its top edge and fades after about 1.5 s. Relais sweeps the airmail stripe in from the left (`--sweep-height` is `--stripe-band`); other looks draw a 3 px `--mustard` line. `--sweep-fill` sets its background.

**Switch.** part `thumb`, on/off from `aria-checked` (or a checked input inside); the thumb stretches while pressed (6 px / 4 px), then lands with `--spring-pop`. Settings: `--switch-thumb`, `--switch-travel`, `--switch-stretch`.
The container a `stamp` lands in: it jolts 2px when a stamp lands, or on `data-state="done"`.

**LiveBand.** part `track` scrolls (give it two copies side by side; `--ticker-time`, 70 s); stops while the element holding it is hovered or focused (a Play button beside it doesn't pause it) and with `data-state="paused"`; under reduced motion it starts paused and `data-state="running"` plays it. Part `dot` pulses while it runs.

**Toast.** enters from below; part `timer` is the clock (`--toast-time`, 5 s): `toastTimer(el)` resolves when its bar runs out and pauses on hover and focus. `data-state="leaving"` exits; remove the toast on `animationend`.
**Drawer, Disclosure.** `data-state="open"`: height and opacity, with `@starting-style`; Discothèque settles with a spring.
**Skeleton.** appears only after 200 ms, so fast loads show no skeleton at all; parts `bone` shimmer, and stop under reduced motion.
**Schedule button.** `data-state="done"`: part `minute` winds two turns and part `hour` three quarters, landing on `--hour` (270deg by default); then the pill (a `seal`) reads the time.
The state a moment shows.
Working: the busy cue (press, save, hold while held).
Unsaved changes (save).
Finished: the moment plays its ending.
Failed or changes asked: a shake or a rust line.
Closing: plays the exit (toast, milestone, dialog).
Picked up (lift).
Open (unfold).
Stopped (ticker).
Shown as it stands, without playing: a record opened later (notary).
Playing, even under reduced motion (ticker).
A part of a moment, on a child of the element with `data-moment`.
